function.name: metasploit_rpc
function.description: Invoke Metasploit via MSFRPC / module run: use a module, set options, and execute. Lab/authorized targets only.

module_name.description: Full module path e.g. exploit/multi/handler or auxiliary/scanner/ssh/ssh_login. null for list.

options.description: Module datastore options (RHOSTS, LHOST, LPORT, PAYLOAD, etc.). null if none.

payload.description: Payload module when action runs an exploit. null for auxiliary/list.
